description: The devops-agent assists with DevOps tasks by providing information about GitHub repositories, CI/CD workflows, Docker images, and relevant documentation through web searches.
name: devops-agent

skills.description: Look up GitHub repo details, stars, forks, and recent activity
examples: What's the status of the kubernetes/kubernetes repo?
skills.name: GitHub Repository Info

skills.description: Check recent GitHub Actions workflow runs and their results
examples: Show recent CI runs for tokio-rs/tokio
skills.name: CI/CD Status

skills.description: Search Docker Hub for container images
examples: Find official PostgreSQL images on Docker Hub
skills.name: Container Image Search

skills.description: Search the web for DevOps documentation, tutorials, and best practices
examples: How do I set up GitHub Actions for Rust?
skills.name: Web Search
